extra.message: User-controlled body.vendorId and body.keyword are concatenated directly into a raw SQL string passed to prisma.$queryRawUnsafe. An attacker who reaches this endpoint can inject arbitrary SQL.

convertCatalogExportDocument builds a shell command via string interpolation of the user-controlled 'format' value (from POST body) and passes it to execSync. A format like '; rm -rf /' or '$(...)' executes arbitrary commands.

runReportEngineViaPreset interpolates the user-controlled 'preset' (plus vendorId) into a shell command and spawns it with shell:true. The preset originates from body.preset (generateVendorLedgerReport), enabling command injection.

previewVendorPayoutAdjustment builds a Function from the user-controlled 'formula' body field: new Function("context", `return ${body.formula}`). This executes arbitrary JavaScript server-side (remote code execution).

readDeclaredEntities parses a user-supplied DOCTYPE and resolves <!ENTITY ... SYSTEM "file:///..."> declarations by calling fs.readFileSync on the SYSTEM path. This is an XXE-style arbitrary local file read reachable via resolveImportPreferences (readCatalogImportPreferences endpoint).
renderStorefrontBanner interpolates the vm_referral cookie value directly into an HTML string sent with res.type("html") without escaping. A crafted cookie yields reflected cross-site scripting.

renderProductQuickViewScript interpolates the x-quickview-label header (or product.name) directly into a <script> element without escaping, allowing script injection (stored/reflected XSS) into the rendered quick-view widget.

getVendorAgreementTemplate joins the user-controlled :templateName path parameter directly into a filesystem path and reads it. templateName like '../../../../etc/passwd' escapes the agreements directory (path traversal / arbitrary file read).

getVendorComplianceArchiveEntry joins the user-controlled :fileName path parameter directly into a filesystem path and reads it without basename/path validation, allowing path traversal and arbitrary file read.

searchStaffDirectoryByPreference builds an LDAP filter string '(uid=' + vm_directory_scope cookie + ')' without escaping. A crafted cookie injects LDAP filter metacharacters to alter directory queries.

lookupShipmentManifestEntry builds an XPath expression by directly embedding the vm_tenant cookie and 'code' query parameter without escaping (the escapeXPathString helper is only used in the -safe variant). This is an XPath injection sink.
resolveStorefrontReturnDestination redirects to a destination taken directly from the x-return-to header or 'back' query parameter with no allow-list, enabling an open redirect.

syncVendorCatalogDataSource fetches a URL fully controlled by the client (x-catalog-source-url header or body.sourceUrl) with no host allow-list, allowing server-side request forgery against internal services.

The /api/disputes/:id/carrier-exception-resolution route is registered without requireAuth or any authentication. applyCarrierExceptionResolution trusts request headers (x-carrier-auto-resolve, x-carrier-confidence-score) to auto-resolve any dispute, allowing unauthenticated state change.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: applyBuyerAccountUpdate merges the entire request body onto the current user record and updates it, excluding only id/passwordHash/createdAt/updatedAt. A buyer can set role=marketplace_admin (or email/disabled/vendorId) to escalate privileges.

applyVendorProfileBulkUpdate merges req.body onto the vendor record (Object.assign({}, vendor, req.body)) and writes it back, stripping only id/createdAt/updatedAt. A vendor manager can set status='active' or overwrite taxIdMasked/payoutDestinationMasked, bypassing admin verification.

updateVendorStorefrontProfile merges req.body onto the vendor record and writes name/description/contactEmail/supportPhone/status/taxIdMasked/payoutDestinationMasked directly from the merged (client-controlled) object. A vendor manager can self-approve by setting status='active' and alter masked payout/tax fields.

searchOrderActivityFeed spreads the entire request body into the Prisma 'where' clause after setting buyerId. A buyer can supply their own buyerId (or any other filter) to override the scoping and read other buyers' orders including shipping details.

createVendorOnboardingInvite generates the onboarding invite code with Math.random().toString(36), which is not cryptographically secure and is predictable, allowing an attacker to guess invite codes.

cwe: CWE-330: Use of Insufficiently Random Values

extra.message: exportDisputeEvidenceBundle places the user-controlled 'export_name' query parameter into the Content-Disposition header without stripping CR/LF, enabling HTTP header injection (response splitting).

openSyndicationLink accepts a JWT-like link with alg:'none' (or any non-HS256 alg) and trusts the unsigned payload outright. serveCatalogSyndicationFeed uses this function with no authentication, so anyone can forge a link to read any vendor's catalog.

cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

extra.message: registerVendorDisplayPreferences performs Object.assign(storefrontDisplayDefaults, req.body) with an unsanitized body. A '__proto__' key in the JSON body can pollute the shared defaults object (the notification-preferences sibling endpoint sanitizes via sanitizeForMerge, but this one does not).
A hardcoded fallback API key 'pfk_7c1a4e9d2b3f6081aa5c' is used when PRICING_FEED_KEY is not set, exposing a credential in source code.
generateVendorRemittanceSummary returns the raw error.message and error.stack to the client, disclosing internal implementation details and stack traces.
